en.name: Mercenary
en.ability: Each night*, gain the ability of a player who publicly claimed Spartacus today. If a Mercenary is exiled, you are exiled too. [+1 Mercenary of opposing alignment]

revisions.v1: Each night*, gain the ability of a player who publicly claimed Spartacus today. If a Mercenary is exiled, you are exiled too. [+1 Mercenary of opposing alignment]

en.otherNightReminder: Show the Mercenary a character that publicly claimed to be Spartacus today, they have that ability tonight and tomorrow until dusk.
